schemaNotice: 專案能力契約，非 B4A 原生 schema；由可信 TourPage 命令註冊。

inputs.project: Validated lumiere-project v2 with captured current native building and embedded GLB/materials/underlays/reference context
inputs.runtime: Trusted fixed same-origin standalone-runtime.json, built only from allowlisted local modules with complete static/literal-dynamic import closure
inputs.view: Exact optional walk/orbit snapshot, existing floor, bounded finite coordinates, camera direction, roof/plan/labels/detail flags

outputs.html: One UTF-8 HTML containing data modules, B4A definition/CSS, project, view and license notices
outputs.download: Browser Blob download; does not overwrite source or the current HTML

dependencies: existing B4A DynamicPageRenderer and registered controls
native browser WebCrypto, Blob, ES modules, import map and WebGL
Node standard library for optional runtime build/CLI

authority.read: Current validated in-memory scene and embedded resources; fixed same-origin runtime manifest only
authority.network: Export preparation reads one fixed same-origin artifact; output CSP blocks HTTP/HTTPS resources, external frames and workers

errors: Invalid or oversized project/runtime/view rejects without download
IFC reference rejects explicitly; never silently omitted
Cancelled/destroyed page or changed source cannot download a stale export
security: Escaped inert user JSON and HTML title; no data-to-code conversion
Trusted static module alias allowlist; no eval or Function
Hash-pinned bootstrap/importmap/CSS; CSS newline normalization before hash
Three MIT and B4A provenance included
lifecycle: Captures current bundle, blocks concurrent export UI, validates geometry stamp, supports AbortController on page destruction; output mounts/cleans up existing native TourPage.
unsupported: Session-only local video/audio and external YouTube

verificationScope.automated: module closure/source freshness; hostile labels; exact assets/view; limits/cancellation; real walk/orbit restore; existing tour regressions
verificationScope.browser: Actual B4A button download, exact source project retention and restored view; isolated one-artifact HTTP preview with no original-site assets; map/WASD/door/edit JSON tested
verificationScope.fileProtocol: Direct file:// test blocked by browser URL security policy; no bypass or alternate browser used. Direct double-click not verified in this environment.

rollback: Remove the additive button/command/import and runtime artifact to withdraw export. Existing native JSON/bundle and viewer behavior remain independently available; exported HTML retains its embedded runtime.
